full_judgment: 9. it must be noticed that evidence of motive is not synonymous with presumption of motive, Former if proved, is circumstantial evidence, but the latter only suspension based on conjectures. If the prosecution could have prove that Kulsum replied that she would depose in the rape case, then the motive of Shahjahan to murder Kulsum would have been proved, but as the prosecution did not prove it, motive of Shahjahan to murder Kulsum rests on suspection which is no proff at all.
